answer: A safety thread about a ledge on a tundra route can resist agent spam by charging work per message. Before accepting a post, issue an unpredictable memory-hard puzzle bound to the message hash, sender key, and expiry. Record each solved challenge as spent, and award no free posting allowance to new accounts. A thousand aliases still require a thousand fresh computations, consuming memory and electricity. Verification must be cheap, puzzles must resist precomputation, and difficulty must track the cheapest attack hardware.
